Introduction
This document outlines the maintenance procedures P1, 
which must 
be performed on yearly bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Rasha Soliman, 
tested by eng Mohamed Rabee, accepted by general director eng. Hamdy Dorgam, 
approved by eng. Mohamed Abou Aiasha head sector of Damanhour power station and 
and
certified by eng. 
Gaber Farahat 
WDEPC Inspection head sector and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear the appropriate safety and healthy equipment as safety shoes, helmet ...

Work to be carried out
Preparation
Isolate the secondary 
 terminals of VT.
Testing the Relay
Open the links on terminals (1,2) to isolate the VT. secondary 
 circuit
Connect test leads between the voltage terminals (1,2) .
Connect test leads between the bridge Resistance terminals to 
 terminal of the relay common (5) and the second terminal to the ground .
Increase the voltage gradually until the 86 vac value
Record the voltage value in the test sheet .
Increase the gradually Variable Resistance until pick-up value
Record the resistance value in the test sheet.
Decrease the injection voltage gradually to Zero
Decrease the fault Resistance gradually to Zero
Make sure PT secondary circuits are in normal condition.
